generated_by: LSA Eval Run 2 - Manual Agent Simulation

findings.title: Any logged-in user can rename any member account via GET mode=edit&member_id=X
findings.description: Classic ASP shop/member.asp allows editing a member's name using the member_id parameter. The page includes inc/auth.asp for login verification, but does NOT check that the logging-in user owns the member account being edited.
findings.remediation: Add ownership verification: Check that the logged-in user's ID (Session("UserID")) matches the member_id before performing UPDATE.

findings.title: Any logged-in user can DELETE any member account via GET mode=delete&member_id=X
findings.description: Critical BOLA vulnerability - deletion endpoint with no ownership check. Attacker can delete other users' accounts by manipulating member_id parameter.
findings.remediation: Add strict owner binding: SELECT * FROM members WHERE member_id = ? AND user_id = Session("UserID") before executing DELETE.

findings.title: Remote CFC method exposed - getOrder returns any order without authentication or ownership check
findings.description: ColdFusion CFC has remote method invocation enabled (access="remote"). No authentication, no ownership verification. Attacker can fetch any order data including sensitive customer addresses.
findings.remediation: Remove remote access or add cfauthentication + user_id filter in query with cfqueryparam binding.

findings.title: SQL Injection in member edit and delete operations via unquoted parameters
findings.description: Both UPDATE (name field) and DELETE statements concatenate user-controlled values directly into SQL query string without proper quoting.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries with ? or :param syntax; for ASP use Server.HTMLEncode combined with CAST/CONVERT.

findings.title: SQL Injection via unparameterized cfquery with remote access
findings.description: cfquery uses #url.id# interpolation without cfqueryparam wrapper, allowing SQL injection. Compounded by remote access being public.
findings.remediation: Wrap id in cfqueryparam: <cfqueryparam value="#arguments.orderId#" cfsqltype="cf_sql_integer">

findings.title: Any user can change any other user's email via edit.do (no ownership verification)
findings.description: Struts 1 action accepts user_id from request, fetches that user record, and updates their email. No check whether current logged-in user owns the record.
findings.remediation: Add owner binding before update: WHERE user_id = ? AND id = ?

findings.title: Per-session user can delete any cart via order.cgi (no ownership check)
findings.description: Perl CGI script loads session and checks user_id in session param, but order deletion concatenates cart parameter directly without verifying cart owner matches current session user.
findings.remediation: Add WHERE clause: DELETE FROM carts WHERE cart_id = ? AND owner_id = Session("user_id")
